observations: Photo 0 shows a white PlayStation 5 Slim console with the PS logo visible on the top panel. A white and black DualSense controller is placed in front of it, along with a power cable and a manual labeled 'PlayStation5' with Chinese text '安全指南'.

Photo 1 shows the same console from a different angle, with the PS logo on the top panel and the DualSense controller beside it. The console appears to be in a protective plastic wrap or cloth. The background includes a white surface and some crumpled paper or fabric.
The console has a slim profile with a black base and a white top, consistent with the PS5 Slim design.
The controller is white with black grips and buttons, matching the console's color scheme.
The manual in photo 0 has 'PlayStation5' and '安全指南' (Safety Guide) visible, but no model number or serial number is readable.
No FIFA disc game is visible in either photo.
The console appears to be new or lightly used, with no visible damage in the photos.

claims.claim: Sony PlayStation 5 Slim console and controller available
claims.evidence: Photos 0 and 1 show a white PlayStation 5 Slim console with a DualSense controller, matching the PS5 Slim design.

claims.claim: it comes with FIFA disc game
claims.evidence: No FIFA disc game is visible in either photo. The seller's text claims it, but no visual proof is provided.

Video of the controller connecting and responding to inputs.
